children: Sun Yuchen said a recent dispute involving him is a routine civil property case that has already entered judicial proceedings. According to ChainCatcher, he said he respects the court, the legal process, and the other party’s rights, and will accept the final outcome.
He also said the matter ends with him and expressed hope that Jing Tian’s future life will no longer be affected by it.

title: Sun Yuchen Says Recent Dispute Is a Civil Property Case and Will Follow Court Ruling
